quote: Railway charges per-second for the CPU, memory, and disk your services actually use. Memory $0.00000386 per GB/s (~$10 per GB-month). CPU $0.00000772 per vCPU/s (~$20 per vCPU-month). Egress $0.05 per GB. Hobby $5/mo includes $5 usage; Pro $20/mo includes $20; Free $1/mo. Included usage is capacity, not durable unit cost.
note: This merchant account's Railway plan, remaining included credits, and idle replica size are unknown. Do not treat a 60s AWS On-Demand minimum as Railway billing.
